summary: Frontend implements a FIAT VPS1 parsing + React Query hook and wires it into AssetSearch with loading/error/retry states and a fallback to the static catalog. However, the diff does not show the required fixed FIAT endpoint URL (http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json) being used/allowlisted on the backend; the only visible FIAT allowlist entries are different HTTPS URLs.

missing_requirements.requirement: Preserve and use the exact FIAT data endpoint URL: http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json (backend-cached VPS1 endpoint used by fetchFiatVPS1Data/getFiatVPS1ValidationResult).
missing_requirements.reason: In the visible backend changes, the FIAT allowlist does not include the required URL and instead lists unrelated endpoints; the required http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json is not present in the diff summary, so it is not evidenced that the backend fetch/cache is pointed at the mandated endpoint.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced/changed backend FIAT allowlist entries to unrelated HTTPS endpoints (e.g., exchangeratesapi.io, api.example.com) rather than the requested VPS1 fx_rates.json URL.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constrains the FIAT data source to a specific URL; adding different allowlisted FIAT endpoints is not requested and may conflict with the constraint.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a new backend-side FiatAssetCacheEntry map/cache structure ('fiatAssetCache') described as 'Migrated Fiat asset cache'.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly states stable migration should not be required and does not request a new backend asset cache structure beyond using the existing cached validation result flow; this additional cache is not requested in REQ-21/REQ-22.
